mapper.select: SELECT target_id FROM user_behavior_log WHERE ( UPPER(target_type) = 'BOOK' OR behavior_type LIKE 'BOOK_%' ) AND target_id IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY target_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(create_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, target_id, target_type, behavior_type, behavior_score, extra_data, create_time FROM user_behavior_log WHERE ( UPPER(target_type) = 'BOOK' OR behavior_type LIKE 'BOOK_%' ) AND target_id = #{bookId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY create_time DESC
